Welcome to Amani

Nature. Relax. Reconnect.

Amani Country Resort is a welcoming destination in Buloba Kiwumu, offering comfortable rooms, food and drinks, wellness experiences, event spaces and beautifully kept gardens.

Whether you are staying overnight, meeting colleagues, celebrating with family or simply taking a quiet break, Amani is designed around comfort and genuine hospitality.
